```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(stringr)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. IDENTIFY THE TOP 100 CRITICAL GRID HOURS OF THE YEAR
# ==============================================================================
top100_slots <- sub_df |>
  group_by(month, day_type, hour_ending) |>
  summarise(
    slot_hours    = round(median(n_hours[n_hours > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    sub_mw_before = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, hourly_kwh / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(sub_mw_before)) |>
  mutate(
    cum_hours    = cumsum(slot_hours),
    prev_hours   = lag(cum_hours, default = 0),
    weight_hours = pmax(0L, as.integer(pmin(slot_hours, 100L - prev_hours)))
  ) |>
  filter(weight_hours > 0)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. VPP SIMULATION FUNCTION (HOLDS CHARGE FOR TOP 100 HOURS + 20% FLOOR)
# ==============================================================================
cap_kwh      <- 20.16
max_kw       <- 7.68
rt_eff       <- 0.894
eta          <- sqrt(rt_eff)
taper_frac   <- 0.45
min_soc_frac <- 0.20                    # 20% outage backup reserve floor
min_soc_kwh  <- cap_kwh * min_soc_frac  # 4.032 kWh reserve (16.13 kWh usable)

simulate_battery_vpp <- function(battery_custs, crit_slots = top100_slots) {
  bat_profiles <- sub_df |>
    filter(CUSTOMER_NUMBER %in% battery_custs) |>
    mutate(avg_kw_before = if_else(n_hours > 0, hourly_kwh / n_hours, 0)) |>
    select(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type, hour_ending, avg_kw_before) |>
    complete(nesting(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
             hour_ending = 1:24, fill = list(avg_kw_before = 0)) |>
    arrange(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type, hour_ending)

  kw_wide <- bat_profiles |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
                names_from = hour_ending, values_from = avg_kw_before)
  kw_mat <- as.matrix(kw_wide[, as.character(1:24)])
  n_prof <- nrow(kw_mat)

  # TOU window matrix
  per_wide <- kw_wide |>
    select(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type) |>
    left_join(df |> select(month, day_type, hour_ending, tou_period),
              by = c("month", "day_type"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
                names_from = hour_ending, values_from = tou_period)
  per_mat <- as.matrix(per_wide[, as.character(1:24)])
  has_peak_day <- rowSums(per_mat == "Peak") > 0

  # Critical-hour matrix (TRUE for Top 100 grid strain hours)
  crit_lookup <- crit_slots |>
    select(month, day_type, hour_ending) |>
    mutate(is_critical = TRUE)

  crit_wide <- kw_wide |>
    select(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type) |>
    crossing(hour_ending = 1:24) |>
    left_join(crit_lookup, by = c("month", "day_type", "hour_ending")) |>
    mutate(is_critical = coalesce(is_critical, FALSE)) |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
                names_from = hour_ending, values_from = is_critical)
  crit_mat <- as.matrix(crit_wide[, as.character(1:24)])
  has_crit_day <- rowSums(crit_mat) > 0

  soc <- rep(min_soc_kwh, n_prof)
  out_mat <- kw_mat

  for (pass in 1:2) {
    for (h in 1:24) {
      l <- pmax(kw_mat[, h], 0)
      p <- per_mat[, h]

      is_charge   <- (p == "Off-peak") & (soc < cap_kwh)
      grid_charge <- ifelse(is_charge,
                            pmin(max_kw, ((cap_kwh - soc) * taper_frac) / eta), 0)
      soc <- soc + grid_charge * eta

      # VPP Rule: On days with Top 100 critical hours, hold charge and discharge ONLY
      # during critical strain hours. On all other days, run standard TOU arbitrage.
      target_window <- ifelse(
        has_crit_day,
        crit_mat[, h],
        (has_peak_day & p == "Peak") | (!has_peak_day & p == "Mid-peak")
      )

      is_discharge <- target_window & (soc > min_soc_kwh) & (l > 0)
      deliver <- ifelse(is_discharge, pmin(l, max_kw, (soc - min_soc_kwh) * eta), 0)
      soc <- soc - deliver / eta

      if (pass == 2) out_mat[, h] <- kw_mat[, h] + grid_charge - deliver
    }
  }

  bat_after_long <- bind_cols(kw_wide |> select(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
                              as_tibble(out_mat)) |>
    pivot_longer(as.character(1:24), names_to = "hour_ending", values_to = "avg_kw_after") |>
    mutate(hour_ending = as.integer(hour_ending))

  sub_df |>
    left_join(bat_after_long, by = c("CUSTOMER_NUMBER", "month", "day_type", "hour_ending")) |>
    mutate(
      has_battery = CUSTOMER_NUMBER %in% battery_custs,
      kwh_before  = hourly_kwh,
      kwh_after   = if_else(has_battery, avg_kw_after * n_hours, hourly_kwh),
      cost_before = kwh_before * tou_rate,
      cost_after  = kwh_after  * tou_rate
    )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 3. RUN VPP SIMULATIONS & COMPUTE TOP 100 HOUR METRICS
# ==============================================================================
names(scenarios)[names(scenarios) == "Random 5%"] <- "Random 1.5%"
inflex_name <- "Inflexible, high peak usage (No Solar/HP/EV)"

if (!inflex_name %in% names(scenarios)) {
  scenarios[[inflex_name]] <- chars |>
    filter(!heatpump, !lvl1EV, !lvl2EV, !is_solar) |>
    inner_join(
      sub_df |>
        group_by(CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
        summarise(peak_kwh = sum(hourly_kwh[tou_period == "Peak"], na.rm = TRUE),
                  .groups = "drop"),
      by = "CUSTOMER_NUMBER"
    ) |>
    slice_max(peak_kwh, n = n_target, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    pull(CUSTOMER_NUMBER)
}

scen_order <- c("Random 1.5%",
                "Green-tech adopters (Solar/HP/EV)",
                "High peak/off-peak ratio",
                "Inflexible, high peak usage (No Solar/HP/EV)")

scen_colors <- c("Random 1.5%"                                   = "#7F7F7F",
                 "Green-tech adopters (Solar/HP/EV)"             = "#2CA02C",
                 "High peak/off-peak ratio"                      = "#D62728",
                 "Inflexible, high peak usage (No Solar/HP/EV)"  = "#9467BD")

sims_vpp <- lapply(scenarios[scen_order], simulate_battery_vpp)

n_sub_custs        <- length(unique(sub_df$CUSTOMER_NUMBER)) # 5,000
scale_sub_to_35k   <- 35000 / n_sub_custs                     # 7.0x
scale_sub_to_nyseg <- 924544 / n_sub_custs                    # 184.91x

top100_hourly_vpp <- bind_rows(lapply(scen_order, function(nm) {
  sims_vpp[[nm]] |>
    inner_join(top100_slots |> select(month, day_type, hour_ending, weight_hours),
               by = c("month", "day_type", "hour_ending")) |>
    group_by(month, day_type, hour_ending, weight_hours) |>
    summarise(
      sub_mw_before      = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, kwh_before / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
      sub_mw_after       = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, kwh_after  / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
      sub_mwh_saved_hr   = sub_mw_before - sub_mw_after,
      ds35k_mwh_saved_hr = sub_mwh_saved_hr * scale_sub_to_35k,
      nyseg_mwh_saved_hr = sub_mwh_saved_hr * scale_sub_to_nyseg,
      fleet_pct_drop     = (sub_mwh_saved_hr / sub_mw_before) * 100,
      enrolled_pct_drop  = (1 - sum(kwh_after[has_battery]) / sum(kwh_before[has_battery])) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(sub_mw_before)) |>
    uncount(weight_hours) |>
    mutate(
      critical_hour_rank = row_number(),
      scenario = factor(nm, levels = scen_order)
    )
}))

top100_summary_vpp <- top100_hourly_vpp |>
  group_by(scenario) |>
  summarise(
    avg_hourly_mwh_35k    = mean(ds35k_mwh_saved_hr),
    avg_hourly_mwh_nyseg  = mean(nyseg_mwh_saved_hr),
    total_100hr_mwh_nyseg = sum(nyseg_mwh_saved_hr),
    avg_fleet_pct_drop    = mean(fleet_pct_drop),
    avg_enrolled_pct_drop = mean(enrolled_pct_drop),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(top100_summary_vpp)

# ==============================================================================
# GRAPH 1A: TOP 100 HOURS AVERAGE MWh SAVED (VPP RESERVE DISPATCH)

p1_mwh_vpp <- ggplot(top100_summary_vpp,
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(stringr)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. SCALING CONSTANTS & SCENARIO SETTINGS
# ==============================================================================
n_sub_custs        <- length(unique(sub_df$CUSTOMER_NUMBER)) # 5,000
n_dataset_custs    <- 35000                                   # Full dataset
n_nyseg_custs      <- 924544                                  # NYSEG territory

scale_sub_to_35k   <- n_dataset_custs / n_sub_custs           # 7.0x
scale_sub_to_nyseg <- n_nyseg_custs / n_sub_custs             # 184.9088x

scen_order <- c("Random 1.5%",
                "Green-tech adopters (Solar/HP/EV)",
                "High peak/off-peak ratio",
                "Inflexible, high peak usage (No Solar/HP/EV)")
scen_order <- intersect(scen_order, names(sims_vpp))

scen_colors <- c("Random 1.5%"                                   = "#7F7F7F",
                 "Green-tech adopters (Solar/HP/EV)"             = "#2CA02C",
                 "High peak/off-peak ratio"                      = "#D62728",
                 "Inflexible, high peak usage (No Solar/HP/EV)"  = "#9467BD")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. COMPUTE ANNUAL TOU SAVINGS FROM sims_vpp (SUBSET, DATASET, & NYSEG)
# ==============================================================================
vpp_tou_savings <- bind_rows(lapply(scen_order, function(nm) {
  df_sim <- sims_vpp[[nm]]

  # Exact annualization factor (1.0 if sub_df already represents 8,760 hrs/yr)
  hrs_per_cust <- df_sim |>
    filter(has_battery) |>
    group_by(CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
    summarise(tot_hrs = sum(n_hours), .groups = "drop") |>
    summarise(mean_hrs = mean(tot_hrs)) |>
    pull(mean_hrs)
  ann_factor <- 8760 / hrs_per_cust

  # Annualized TOU bill difference for each enrolled battery household
  cust_savings <- df_sim |>
    filter(has_battery) |>
    group_by(CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
    summarise(
      annual_bill_before = sum(cost_before) * ann_factor,
      annual_bill_after  = sum(cost_after)  * ann_factor,
      annual_saved       = annual_bill_before - annual_bill_after,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  subset_total_usd <- sum(cust_savings$annual_saved)

  tibble(
    scenario                 = nm,
    n_batteries_subset       = nrow(cust_savings),
    per_cust_annual_saved    = mean(cust_savings$annual_saved),
    subset_5k_annual_saved   = subset_total_usd,
    dataset_35k_annual_saved = subset_total_usd * scale_sub_to_35k,
    nyseg_924k_annual_saved  = subset_total_usd * scale_sub_to_nyseg
  )
}))

# Print the exact dollar table
print(vpp_tou_savings)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. 4-PANEL PLOT: PER CUSTOMER, SUBSET (5k), DATASET (35k), & NYSEG (924.5k)
# ==============================================================================
plot_vpp_savings_df <- vpp_tou_savings |>
  mutate(
    scenario    = factor(scenario, levels = rev(scen_order)),
    dataset_35k = dataset_35k_annual_saved / 1e3, # Convert to $K/yr for clean axis
    nyseg_924k  = nyseg_924k_annual_saved  / 1e6  # Convert to $M/yr for clean axis
  ) |>
  select(scenario,
         per_cust_annual_saved,

      metric == "Full Dataset: 35,000 Customers ($K/yr)" ~ paste0("$", comma(val, accuracy = 1), "K"),

    )
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(stringr)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. NYSEG TARIFF PARAMETERS (FROM RATE CARD) & SCALING CONSTANTS
# ==============================================================================
# Standard Tariff
std_fixed_yr  <- 19 * 12      # $19/month = $228/year fixed delivery charge
std_deliv_kwh <- 0.09138      # $0.09138/kWh volumetric delivery rate

# Time-of-Use (TOU) Tariff
tou_fixed_yr  <- 30 * 12      # $30/month = $360/year fixed delivery charge
tou_deliv_kwh <- 0.07011      # $0.07011/kWh volumetric delivery rate
tou_min_kwh   <- 35000        # +35,000 kWh/year minimum usage requirement

# Fleet load-weighted flat Standard supply rate (revenue-neutral to 3-tier TOU supply)
# Replace with a specific SC-1 supply rate (e.g., 0.088) if desired
std_supply_rate <- if ("std_rate" %in% names(sub_df)) {
  mean(sub_df$std_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  sum(sub_df$hourly_kwh * sub_df$tou_rate, na.rm = TRUE) /
    sum(sub_df$hourly_kwh, na.rm = TRUE)
}

n_sub_custs        <- length(unique(sub_df$CUSTOMER_NUMBER)) # 5,000
scale_sub_to_35k   <- 35000 / n_sub_custs                     # 7.0x
scale_sub_to_nyseg <- 924544 / n_sub_custs                    # 184.9088x

scen_order <- c("Random 1.5%",
                "Green-tech adopters (Solar/HP/EV)",
                "High peak/off-peak ratio",
                "Inflexible, high peak usage (No Solar/HP/EV)")
scen_order <- intersect(scen_order, names(sims_vpp))

scen_colors <- c("Random 1.5%"                                   = "#7F7F7F",
                 "Green-tech adopters (Solar/HP/EV)"             = "#2CA02C",
                 "High peak/off-peak ratio"                      = "#D62728",
                 "Inflexible, high peak usage (No Solar/HP/EV)"  = "#9467BD")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. COMPUTE ANNUAL BILLS & MONEY SAVED ACROSS ALL 3 TARIFF REGIMES
# ==============================================================================
tariff_savings_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(scen_order, function(nm) {
  df_sim <- sims_vpp[[nm]]

  hrs_per_cust <- df_sim |>
    filter(has_battery) |>
    group_by(CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
    summarise(tot_hrs = sum(n_hours), .groups = "drop") |>
    summarise(mean_hrs = mean(tot_hrs)) |>
    pull(mean_hrs)
  ann_factor <- 8760 / hrs_per_cust

  cust_bills <- df_sim |>
    filter(has_battery) |>
    group_by(CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
    summarise(
      ann_kwh_before = sum(kwh_before) * ann_factor,
      ann_kwh_after  = sum(kwh_after)  * ann_factor,

      # Annual bill on Standard Tariff (Before & After Battery)
      bill_std_before = std_fixed_yr + ann_kwh_before * (std_supply_rate + std_deliv_kwh),
      bill_std_after  = std_fixed_yr + ann_kwh_after  * (std_supply_rate + std_deliv_kwh),

      # Annual bill on TOU Tariff (Before & After Battery)
      bill_tou_before = tou_fixed_yr +
        sum(kwh_before * (tou_rate + tou_deliv_kwh)) * ann_factor,
      bill_tou_after  = tou_fixed_yr +
        sum(kwh_after  * (tou_rate + tou_deliv_kwh)) * ann_factor,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      # Regime 1: Standard Pricing Only (Standard -> Standard + Battery)
      saved_regime1_std = bill_std_before - bill_std_after,

      # Regime 2: TOU Pricing Only (TOU -> TOU + Battery)
      saved_regime2_tou = bill_tou_before - bill_tou_after,

      # Regime 3: Battery-Triggered TOU Incentive (Standard -> TOU + Battery)
      saved_regime3_inc = bill_std_before - bill_tou_after,

      meets_35k_tou_rule = ann_kwh_before >= tou_min_kwh
    )

  tibble(
    scenario          = nm,
    pct_eligible_35k  = mean(cust_bills$meets_35k_tou_rule) * 100,
    avg_kwh_yr        = mean(cust_bills$ann_kwh_before),

    # Regime 1: Standard Only
    r1_per_cust       = mean(cust_bills$saved_regime1_std),
    r1_sub_5k         = sum(cust_bills$saved_regime1_std),
    r1_ds_35k         = sum(cust_bills$saved_regime1_std) * scale_sub_to_35k,
    r1_nyseg_924k     = sum(cust_bills$saved_regime1_std) * scale_sub_to_nyseg,

    # Regime 2: TOU Only
    r2_per_cust       = mean(cust_bills$saved_regime2_tou),
    r2_sub_5k         = sum(cust_bills$saved_regime2_tou),
    r2_ds_35k         = sum(cust_bills$saved_regime2_tou) * scale_sub_to_35k,
    r2_nyseg_924k     = sum(cust_bills$saved_regime2_tou) * scale_sub_to_nyseg,

    # Regime 3: Incentivized TOU Access (Standard Baseline -> TOU + Battery)
    r3_per_cust       = mean(cust_bills$saved_regime3_inc),
    r3_sub_5k         = sum(cust_bills$saved_regime3_inc),
    r3_ds_35k         = sum(cust_bills$saved_regime3_inc) * scale_sub_to_35k,
    r3_nyseg_924k     = sum(cust_bills$saved_regime3_inc) * scale_sub_to_nyseg
  )
}))

print(tariff_savings_raw)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. HELPER FUNCTION TO BUILD 4-SCALE MONEY SAVED PLOT FOR EACH TARIFF REGIME
# ==============================================================================
make_tariff_plot <- function(df_summary, prefix, plot_title, plot_subtitle) {
  df_long <- df_summary |>
    transmute(
      scenario    = factor(scenario, levels = rev(scen_order)),
      per_cust    = .data[[paste0(prefix, "_per_cust")]],
      sub_5k      = .data[[paste0(prefix, "_sub_5k")]],
      ds_35k_k    = .data[[paste0(prefix, "_ds_35k")]] / 1e3,
      nyseg_m     = .data[[paste0(prefix, "_nyseg_924k")]] / 1e6
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = c(per_cust, sub_5k, ds_35k_k, nyseg_m),
                 names_to = "scale_tier", values_to = "val") |>
    mutate(
      scale_tier = factor(
        scale_tier,
        levels = c("per_cust", "sub_5k", "ds_35k_k", "nyseg_m"),
        labels = c("Per Enrolled Customer ($/yr)",
                   "Subset: 5,000 Customers ($/yr)",
                   "Full Dataset: 35,000 Customers ($K/yr)",
                   "NYSEG Territory: 924,544 Customers ($M/yr)")
      ),
      lbl = case_when(
        scale_tier %in% c("Per Enrolled Customer ($/yr)",
                          "Subset: 5,000 Customers ($/yr)") ~
          ifelse(val < 0, paste0("-$", comma(abs(val), accuracy = 1)),
                          paste0("$", comma(val, accuracy = 1))),
        scale_tier == "Full Dataset: 35,000 Customers ($K/yr)" ~
          ifelse(val < 0, sprintf("-$%.1fK", abs(val)), sprintf("$%.1fK", val)),
        TRUE ~
          ifelse(val < 0, sprintf("-$%.2fM", abs(val)), sprintf("$%.2fM", val))
      ),
      hjust_val = ifelse(val >= 0, -0.08, 1.08)
    )

  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = val, y = scenario, fill = scenario)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#1B2A4A", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_col(width = 0.58, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = lbl, hjust = hjust_val), size = 3.5,
              fontface = "bold", color = "#1B2A4A") +
    facet_wrap(~ scale_tier, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = scen_colors) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 26)) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.28, 0.30))) +
    labs(title = plot_title, subtitle = plot_subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "grey30"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"))
}

# ==============================================================================
# PLOT 1: STANDARD PRICING ONLY (STANDARD -> STANDARD + BATTERY)
# ==============================================================================
p_plot1_standard <- make_tariff_plot(
  tariff_savings_raw, "r1",
  "Plot 1: Annual Money Saved on Standard Pricing Only",
  "Baseline: Standard ($19/mo + $0.09138/kWh + flat supply) vs. Battery on Standard (RTE loss = negative savings)"
)
print(p_plot1_standard)

# ==============================================================================
# PLOT 2: TOU PRICING ONLY (TOU -> TOU + BATTERY)
# ==============================================================================
p_plot2_tou <- make_tariff_plot(
  tariff_savings_raw, "r2",
  "Plot 2: Annual Money Saved on Time-of-Use (TOU) Pricing Only",
  "Baseline: TOU ($30/mo + $0.07011/kWh + 3-tier supply) vs. Battery on TOU (1.5% adoption, 20% reserve)"
)
print(p_plot2_tou)

# ==============================================================================
# PLOT 3: BATTERY-TRIGGERED TOU INCENTIVE (STANDARD -> TOU + BATTERY)
# ==============================================================================
p_plot3_incentive <- make_tariff_plot(
  tariff_savings_raw, "r3",
  "Plot 3: Annual Money Saved via Battery TOU Incentive (Standard → TOU)",
  "Baseline: Actual Standard Bill vs. Battery + TOU Access (waiving 35,000 kWh/yr minimum usage rule)"
)
print(p_plot3_incentive)

# ==============================================================================
# SUMMARY SIDE-BY-SIDE: PER-CUSTOMER ANNUAL MONEY SAVED ACROSS ALL 3 REGIMES
# ==============================================================================
compare_3_df <- tariff_savings_raw |>
  select(scenario, r1_per_cust, r2_per_cust, r3_per_cust) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(r1_per_cust, r2_per_cust, r3_per_cust),
               names_to = "regime", values_to = "saved_yr") |>
  mutate(

    ),

p_compare_3 <- ggplot(compare_3_df, aes(x = saved_yr, y = scenario, fill = scenario)) +
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(stringr)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. COHORT CONSTRUCTION: 1.5% ADOPTION (60% FLEXIBLE EV + 40% INFLEXIBLE)
# ==============================================================================
n_sub_custs        <- length(unique(sub_df$CUSTOMER_NUMBER)) # 5,000
n_dataset_custs    <- 35000                                   # Full dataset
n_nyseg_custs      <- 924544                                  # NYSEG territory

scale_sub_to_35k   <- n_dataset_custs / n_sub_custs           # 7.0x
scale_sub_to_nyseg <- n_nyseg_custs / n_sub_custs             # 184.9088x

adoption_rate      <- 0.015                                   # 1.5% adoption
n_target_sub       <- round(n_sub_custs * adoption_rate)      # 75 batteries in 5k subset
n_flex_ev          <- round(n_target_sub * 0.60)              # 45 Flexible EV adopters (60%)
n_inflex           <- n_target_sub - n_flex_ev                # 30 Inflexible high-peak users (40%)

# Customer peak & off-peak usage summary
cust_usage_summary <- sub_df |>
  group_by(CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
  summarise(
    total_kwh   = sum(hourly_kwh, na.rm = TRUE),
    peak_kwh    = sum(hourly_kwh[tou_period == "Peak"], na.rm = TRUE),
    offpeak_kwh = sum(hourly_kwh[tou_period == "Off-peak"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 60% Group: Flexible users who already own an EV (Level 1 or Level 2)
flex_ev_custs <- chars |>
  filter(lvl1EV | lvl2EV) |>
  inner_join(cust_usage_summary, by = "CUSTOMER_NUMBER") |>
  arrange(desc(peak_kwh), CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
  slice_head(n = n_flex_ev) |>
  pull(CUSTOMER_NUMBER)

# 40% Group: Inflexible high-peak users (No Solar, No Heat Pump, No EV)
inflex_custs <- chars |>
  filter(!heatpump, !lvl1EV, !lvl2EV, !is_solar,
         !CUSTOMER_NUMBER %in% flex_ev_custs) |>
  inner_join(cust_usage_summary, by = "CUSTOMER_NUMBER") |>
  arrange(desc(peak_kwh), CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
  slice_head(n = n_inflex) |>
  pull(CUSTOMER_NUMBER)

blended_cohort_tbl <- tibble(
  CUSTOMER_NUMBER = c(flex_ev_custs, inflex_custs),
  sub_segment     = c(rep("Flexible EV Adopters (60%)", length(flex_ev_custs)),
                      rep("Inflexible High-Peak (40%)", length(inflex_custs)))
)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. IDENTIFY TOP 100 CRITICAL GRID STRAIN HOURS OF THE YEAR
# ==============================================================================
top100_slots <- sub_df |>
  group_by(month, day_type, hour_ending) |>
  summarise(
    slot_hours    = round(median(n_hours[n_hours > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    sub_mw_before = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, hourly_kwh / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(sub_mw_before)) |>
  mutate(
    cum_hours    = cumsum(slot_hours),
    prev_hours   = lag(cum_hours, default = 0),
    weight_hours = pmax(0L, as.integer(pmin(slot_hours, 100L - prev_hours)))
  ) |>
  filter(weight_hours > 0)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. RUN VPP RESERVE DISPATCH SIMULATION WITH 20% BACKUP RESERVE FLOOR
# ==============================================================================
cap_kwh      <- 20.16                   # Enphase IQ Battery 10C nameplate (kWh)
max_kw       <- 7.68                    # Max continuous power (kW)
rt_eff       <- 0.894                   # 89.4% round-trip efficiency
eta          <- sqrt(rt_eff)
taper_frac   <- 0.45
min_soc_frac <- 0.20                    # 20% outage backup reserve floor
min_soc_kwh  <- cap_kwh * min_soc_frac  # 4.032 kWh reserve (16.128 kWh usable)

simulate_final_vpp <- function(battery_custs, crit_slots = top100_slots) {
  bat_profiles <- sub_df |>
    filter(CUSTOMER_NUMBER %in% battery_custs) |>
    mutate(avg_kw_before = if_else(n_hours > 0, hourly_kwh / n_hours, 0)) |>
    select(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type, hour_ending, avg_kw_before) |>
    complete(nesting(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
             hour_ending = 1:24, fill = list(avg_kw_before = 0)) |>
    arrange(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type, hour_ending)

  kw_wide <- bat_profiles |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
                names_from = hour_ending, values_from = avg_kw_before)
  kw_mat <- as.matrix(kw_wide[, as.character(1:24)])
  n_prof <- nrow(kw_mat)

  per_wide <- kw_wide |>
    select(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type) |>
    left_join(df |> select(month, day_type, hour_ending, tou_period),
              by = c("month", "day_type"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
                names_from = hour_ending, values_from = tou_period)
  per_mat <- as.matrix(per_wide[, as.character(1:24)])
  has_peak_day <- rowSums(per_mat == "Peak") > 0

  crit_lookup <- crit_slots |>
    select(month, day_type, hour_ending) |>
    mutate(is_critical = TRUE)

  crit_wide <- kw_wide |>
    select(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type) |>
    crossing(hour_ending = 1:24) |>
    left_join(crit_lookup, by = c("month", "day_type", "hour_ending")) |>
    mutate(is_critical = coalesce(is_critical, FALSE)) |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
                names_from = hour_ending, values_from = is_critical)
  crit_mat <- as.matrix(crit_wide[, as.character(1:24)])
  has_crit_day <- rowSums(crit_mat) > 0

  soc <- rep(min_soc_kwh, n_prof)
  out_mat <- kw_mat
  disch_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_prof, ncol = 24,
                      dimnames = list(NULL, as.character(1:24)))

  for (pass in 1:2) {
    for (h in 1:24) {
      l <- pmax(kw_mat[, h], 0)
      p <- per_mat[, h]

      is_charge   <- (p == "Off-peak") & (soc < cap_kwh)
      grid_charge <- ifelse(is_charge,
                            pmin(max_kw, ((cap_kwh - soc) * taper_frac) / eta), 0)
      soc <- soc + grid_charge * eta

      target_window <- ifelse(
        has_crit_day,
        crit_mat[, h],
        (has_peak_day & p == "Peak") | (!has_peak_day & p == "Mid-peak")
      )

      is_discharge <- target_window & (soc > min_soc_kwh) & (l > 0)
      deliver <- ifelse(is_discharge, pmin(l, max_kw, (soc - min_soc_kwh) * eta), 0)
      soc <- soc - deliver / eta

      if (pass == 2) {
        out_mat[, h]   <- kw_mat[, h] + grid_charge - deliver
        disch_mat[, h] <- deliver
      }
    }
  }

  bat_after_long <- bind_cols(kw_wide |> select(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
                              as_tibble(out_mat)) |>
    pivot_longer(as.character(1:24), names_to = "hour_ending", values_to = "avg_kw_after") |>
    mutate(hour_ending = as.integer(hour_ending))

  bat_disch_long <- bind_cols(kw_wide |> select(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, month, day_type),
                              as_tibble(disch_mat)) |>
    pivot_longer(as.character(1:24), names_to = "hour_ending", values_to = "avg_kw_discharged") |>
    mutate(hour_ending = as.integer(hour_ending))

  sub_df |>
    left_join(bat_after_long, by = c("CUSTOMER_NUMBER", "month", "day_type", "hour_ending")) |>
    left_join(bat_disch_long, by = c("CUSTOMER_NUMBER", "month", "day_type", "hour_ending")) |>
    left_join(blended_cohort_tbl, by = "CUSTOMER_NUMBER") |>
    mutate(
      has_battery    = !is.na(sub_segment),
      sub_segment    = coalesce(sub_segment, "Non-Battery Customer"),
      kwh_before     = hourly_kwh,
      kwh_after      = if_else(has_battery, avg_kw_after * n_hours, hourly_kwh),
      kwh_discharged = if_else(has_battery, avg_kw_discharged * n_hours, 0)
    )
}
sim_final <- simulate_final_vpp(blended_cohort_tbl$CUSTOMER_NUMBER)

# Exact annualization factor
hrs_per_cust <- sim_final |>
  filter(has_battery) |>
  group_by(CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
  summarise(tot_hrs = sum(n_hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  summarise(mean_hrs = mean(tot_hrs)) |>
  pull(mean_hrs)
ann_factor <- 8760 / hrs_per_cust

# ==============================================================================
# 4. STATISTIC A: BATTERY CAPACITY & ENERGY GENERATED AT EACH LEVEL
# ==============================================================================
ann_disch_sub_mwh <- sum(sim_final$kwh_discharged) * ann_factor / 1000
crit_disch_sub_mwh <- sim_final |>
  inner_join(top100_slots |> select(month, day_type, hour_ending, weight_hours),
             by = c("month", "day_type", "hour_ending")) |>
  mutate(kw_disch = if_else(n_hours > 0, kwh_discharged / n_hours, 0)) |>
  summarise(mwh = sum(kw_disch * weight_hours) / 1000) |>
  pull(mwh)

capacity_stats_tbl <- tibble(
  Level = c("Per Enrolled Battery",
            "Subset (5,000 Customers)",
            "Full Dataset (35,000 Customers)",
            "NYSEG Territory (924,544 Customers)"),
  Scale_Factor = c(1 / n_target_sub, 1, scale_sub_to_35k, scale_sub_to_nyseg),
  Batteries_Deployed = round(n_target_sub * Scale_Factor),
  Nameplate_Capacity_MWh = (n_target_sub * cap_kwh / 1000) * Scale_Factor,
  Usable_VPP_Capacity_MWh = (n_target_sub * (cap_kwh - min_soc_kwh) / 1000) * Scale_Factor,
  Backup_Reserve_20pct_MWh = (n_target_sub * min_soc_kwh / 1000) * Scale_Factor,
  Max_Inverter_Power_MW = (n_target_sub * max_kw / 1000) * Scale_Factor,
  Annual_Energy_Discharged_MWh = ann_disch_sub_mwh * Scale_Factor,
  Top100_Hours_Energy_Discharged_MWh = crit_disch_sub_mwh * Scale_Factor
)

cat("\n==================== 1. BATTERY CAPACITY & ENERGY GENERATED ====================\n")
print(capacity_stats_tbl, width = Inf)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. STATISTIC B: MONEY SAVED AT EACH LEVEL (STANDARD BASELINE -> TOU + BATTERY)
# ==============================================================================
std_fixed_yr  <- 19 * 12      # $228/yr ($19/mo)
std_deliv_kwh <- 0.09138      # $0.09138/kWh
tou_fixed_yr  <- 30 * 12      # $360/yr ($30/mo)
tou_deliv_kwh <- 0.07011      # $0.07011/kWh

std_supply_rate <- if ("std_rate" %in% names(sub_df)) {
  mean(sub_df$std_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  sum(sub_df$hourly_kwh * sub_df$tou_rate, na.rm = TRUE) /
    sum(sub_df$hourly_kwh, na.rm = TRUE)
}

cust_money_saved <- sim_final |>
  filter(has_battery) |>
  group_by(CUSTOMER_NUMBER, sub_segment) |>
  summarise(
    ann_kwh_before  = sum(kwh_before) * ann_factor,
    ann_kwh_after   = sum(kwh_after)  * ann_factor,
    bill_std_before = std_fixed_yr + ann_kwh_before * (std_supply_rate + std_deliv_kwh),
    bill_tou_after  = tou_fixed_yr + sum(kwh_after * (tou_rate + tou_deliv_kwh)) * ann_factor,
    annual_saved    = bill_std_before - bill_tou_after,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Sub-cohort breakdown (60% EV vs 40% Inflexible)
subsegment_money_tbl <- cust_money_saved |>
  group_by(sub_segment) |>
  summarise(
    n_batteries_5k     = n(),
    avg_kwh_yr         = mean(ann_kwh_before),
    avg_std_bill_yr    = mean(bill_std_before),
    avg_tou_bat_bill   = mean(bill_tou_after),
    avg_saved_per_cust = mean(annual_saved),
    subset_5k_saved    = sum(annual_saved),
    dataset_35k_saved  = sum(annual_saved) * scale_sub_to_35k,
    nyseg_924k_saved   = sum(annual_saved) * scale_sub_to_nyseg,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combined blended portfolio money saved across all levels
total_sub_saved <- sum(cust_money_saved$annual_saved)
money_saved_levels_tbl <- tibble(
  Level = c("Per Enrolled Customer (Blended Avg)",
            "  - Flexible EV Adopters (60% share)",
            "  - Inflexible High-Peak (40% share)",
            "Subset (5,000 Customers / 75 Batteries)",
            "Full Dataset (35,000 Customers / 525 Batteries)",
            "NYSEG Territory (924,544 Customers / 13,868 Batteries)"),
  Annual_Money_Saved_USD = c(
    mean(cust_money_saved$annual_saved),
    mean(cust_money_saved$annual_saved[cust_money_saved$sub_segment == "Flexible EV Adopters (60%)"]),
    mean(cust_money_saved$annual_saved[cust_money_saved$sub_segment == "Inflexible High-Peak (40%)"]),
    total_sub_saved,
    total_sub_saved * scale_sub_to_35k,
    total_sub_saved * scale_sub_to_nyseg
  )
)

cat("\n==================== 2. MONEY SAVED (STANDARD -> TOU INCENTIVE) ====================\n")
print(money_saved_levels_tbl, width = Inf)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. STATISTIC C: PEAK HOURS LOAD DECREASE (% AND MWh AT EACH LEVEL)
# ==============================================================================
# C1: Across ALL TOU Peak hours of the year
all_tou_peak <- sim_final |>
  filter(tou_period == "Peak") |>
  summarise(
    total_peak_hours      = sum(n_hours[CUSTOMER_NUMBER == first(CUSTOMER_NUMBER)]),
    sub_mwh_before        = sum(kwh_before) * ann_factor / 1000,
    sub_mwh_after         = sum(kwh_after)  * ann_factor / 1000,
    sub_mwh_saved_yr      = sub_mwh_before - sub_mwh_after,
    fleet_pct_drop        = (sub_mwh_saved_yr / sub_mwh_before) * 100,
    enrolled_pct_drop     = (1 - sum(kwh_after[has_battery]) / sum(kwh_before[has_battery])) * 100
  )

# C2: Across TOP 100 Critical Grid Strain Hours of the year
top100_ranked <- sim_final |>
  inner_join(top100_slots |> select(month, day_type, hour_ending, weight_hours),
             by = c("month", "day_type", "hour_ending")) |>
  group_by(month, day_type, hour_ending, weight_hours) |>
  summarise(
    sub_mw_before      = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, kwh_before / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
    sub_mw_after       = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, kwh_after  / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
    sub_mwh_saved_hr   = sub_mw_before - sub_mw_after,
    ds35k_mwh_saved_hr = sub_mwh_saved_hr * scale_sub_to_35k,
    nyseg_mwh_saved_hr = sub_mwh_saved_hr * scale_sub_to_nyseg,
    fleet_pct_drop     = (sub_mwh_saved_hr / sub_mw_before) * 100,
    enrolled_pct_drop  = (1 - sum(kwh_after[has_battery]) / sum(kwh_before[has_battery])) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(sub_mw_before)) |>
  uncount(weight_hours) |>
  mutate(critical_hour_rank = row_number())

peak_load_summary_tbl <- tibble(
  Window = c("All Annual TOU Peak Hours",
             "Top 100 Critical Grid Hours (Mean/hr)",
             "Top 10 Most Extreme Hours (Mean/hr)",
             "Single #1 Worst Grid Strain Hour"),
  Fleet_Load_Drop_Pct = c(
    all_tou_peak$fleet_pct_drop,
    mean(top100_ranked$fleet_pct_drop),
    mean(top100_ranked$fleet_pct_drop[1:10]),
    top100_ranked$fleet_pct_drop[1]
  ),
  Enrolled_Cohort_Drop_Pct = c(
    all_tou_peak$enrolled_pct_drop,
    mean(top100_ranked$enrolled_pct_drop),
    mean(top100_ranked$enrolled_pct_drop[1:10]),
    top100_ranked$enrolled_pct_drop[1]
  ),
  Subset_5k_MWh_Saved = c(
    all_tou_peak$sub_mwh_saved_yr,      # Cumulative annual MWh
    mean(top100_ranked$sub_mwh_saved_hr), # MWh/hr
    mean(top100_ranked$sub_mwh_saved_hr[1:10]),
    top100_ranked$sub_mwh_saved_hr[1]
  ),
  Dataset_35k_MWh_Saved = c(
    all_tou_peak$sub_mwh_saved_yr * scale_sub_to_35k,
    mean(top100_ranked$ds35k_mwh_saved_hr),
    mean(top100_ranked$ds35k_mwh_saved_hr[1:10]),
    top100_ranked$ds35k_mwh_saved_hr[1]
  ),
  NYSEG_924k_MWh_Saved = c(
    all_tou_peak$sub_mwh_saved_yr * scale_sub_to_nyseg,
    mean(top100_ranked$nyseg_mwh_saved_hr),
    mean(top100_ranked$nyseg_mwh_saved_hr[1:10]),
    top100_ranked$nyseg_mwh_saved_hr[1]
  )
)

cat("\n==================== 3. PEAK LOAD DECREASE (% AND MWh) ====================\n")
cat("(Note: Row 1 is cumulative annual TOU Peak MWh; Rows 2-4 are MWh/hr)\n")
print(peak_load_summary_tbl, width = Inf)

cat("\n==================== 4. TOP 15 MOST EXTREME CRITICAL HOURS ====================\n")
print(
  top100_ranked |>
    select(critical_hour_rank, month, day_type, hour_ending,
           sub_mwh_saved_hr, ds35k_mwh_saved_hr, nyseg_mwh_saved_hr,
           fleet_pct_drop, enrolled_pct_drop) |>
    slice_head(n = 15),
  width = Inf
)

# ==============================================================================
# 7. VISUALIZATION: TOP 100 CRITICAL HOURS LOAD REDUCTION CURVE (NYSEG SCALE)
# ==============================================================================
avg_nyseg_top100 <- mean(top100_ranked$nyseg_mwh_saved_hr)
avg_pct_top100   <- mean(top100_ranked$fleet_pct_drop)
cum_nyseg_top100 <- sum(top100_ranked$nyseg_mwh_saved_hr)

p_final_top100 <- ggplot(top100_ranked,
                         aes(x = critical_hour_rank, y = nyseg_mwh_saved_hr)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#2B5C8F", alpha = 0.28) +
  geom_line(color = "#1B2A4A", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = avg_nyseg_top100, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "#D62728", linewidth = 0.9) +
  annotate("label", x = 98, y = avg_nyseg_top100,
           label = sprintf("100-Hr Mean: %.1f MWh/hr (%.2f%% fleet drop)\nTotal 100-Hr Shaved: %s MWh",
                           avg_nyseg_top100, avg_pct_top100,
                           comma(round(cum_nyseg_top100))),
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.25, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold",
           fill = "white", color = "#1B2A4A") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100),
                     labels = c("Hour #1\n(Worst Peak)", "#20", "#40", "#60", "#80", "Hour #100")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(
    title = "Final Realistic VPP Deployment: Top 100 Critical Grid Strain Hours",
    subtitle = "1.5% Adoption (60% Flexible EV + 40% Inflexible) | 20% Backup Floor | NYSEG Scale (13,868 Batteries)",
    x = "Critical Grid Strain Hour Rank (Top 100 Hours of Year)",
    y = "Peak Load Shaved per Hour (MWh / hr)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12.5) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "grey30"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_final_top100)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(scales)

# ==============================================================================
# UNIFIED ANNUAL SUMMARY TABLE ("JUST THE NUMBERS")
# ==============================================================================
ann_disch_sub_mwh   <- sum(sim_final$kwh_discharged) * ann_factor / 1000
total_sub_saved     <- sum(cust_money_saved$annual_saved)
sub_tou_peak_mwh    <- all_tou_peak$sub_mwh_saved_yr
sub_top100_cum_mwh  <- sum(top100_ranked$sub_mwh_saved_hr)
sub_top100_mean_mwh <- mean(top100_ranked$sub_mwh_saved_hr)
sub_top1_mwh        <- top100_ranked$sub_mwh_saved_hr[1]

ev_avg_saved <- cust_money_saved |>
  filter(sub_segment == "Flexible EV Adopters (60%)") |>
  summarise(m = mean(annual_saved)) |> pull(m)

inflex_avg_saved <- cust_money_saved |>
  filter(sub_segment == "Inflexible High-Peak (40%)") |>
  summarise(m = mean(annual_saved)) |> pull(m)

# 1. Raw numeric table (for exporting to CSV or further calculations)
final_summary_raw <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Batteries Deployed (1.5% Adoption)",
    "Nameplate Battery Capacity (MWh)",
    "Usable VPP Capacity - 80% Active (MWh)",
    "Backup Reserve Floor - 20% Protected (MWh)",
    "Max Inverter Power (MW)",
    "Annual Energy Discharged by Batteries (MWh/yr)",
    "Annual Bill Savings: Standard -> TOU + Battery ($/yr)",
    "  - Flexible EV Adopter Avg Savings ($/yr per cust)",
    "  - Inflexible High-Peak Avg Savings ($/yr per cust)",
    "Annual TOU Peak Load Shaved (MWh/yr)",
    "Annual TOU Peak Fleet Load Drop (%)",
    "Annual TOU Peak Enrolled Load Drop (%)",
    "Top 100 Critical Hours: Cumulative Shaved (MWh/yr)",
    "Top 100 Critical Hours: Mean Hourly Shave (MWh/hr)",
    "Top 100 Critical Hours: Mean Fleet Load Drop (%)",
    "Top 100 Critical Hours: Mean Enrolled Load Drop (%)",
    "#1 Worst Grid Strain Hour: Shaved (MWh/hr)",
    "#1 Worst Grid Strain Hour: Fleet Load Drop (%)"
  ),
  Per_Battery = c(
    1,
    cap_kwh / 1000,
    (cap_kwh - min_soc_kwh) / 1000,
    min_soc_kwh / 1000,
    max_kw / 1000,
    ann_disch_sub_mwh / n_target_sub,
    total_sub_saved / n_target_sub,
    ev_avg_saved,
    inflex_avg_saved,
    sub_tou_peak_mwh / n_target_sub,
    NA_real_,
    all_tou_peak$enrolled_pct_drop,
    sub_top100_cum_mwh / n_target_sub,
    sub_top100_mean_mwh / n_target_sub,
    NA_real_,
    mean(top100_ranked$enrolled_pct_drop),
    sub_top1_mwh / n_target_sub,
    NA_real_
  ),
  Subset_5k = c(
    n_target_sub,
    n_target_sub * cap_kwh / 1000,
    n_target_sub * (cap_kwh - min_soc_kwh) / 1000,
    n_target_sub * min_soc_kwh / 1000,
    n_target_sub * max_kw / 1000,
    ann_disch_sub_mwh,
    total_sub_saved,
    ev_avg_saved,
    inflex_avg_saved,
    sub_tou_peak_mwh,
    all_tou_peak$fleet_pct_drop,
    all_tou_peak$enrolled_pct_drop,
    sub_top100_cum_mwh,
    sub_top100_mean_mwh,
    mean(top100_ranked$fleet_pct_drop),
    mean(top100_ranked$enrolled_pct_drop),
    sub_top1_mwh,
    top100_ranked$fleet_pct_drop[1]
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    Dataset_35k = ifelse(
      grepl("\\(%\\)|per cust", Metric),
      Subset_5k,
      Subset_5k * scale_sub_to_35k
    ),
    NYSEG_924k = ifelse(
      grepl("\\(%\\)|per cust", Metric),
      Subset_5k,
      Subset_5k * scale_sub_to_nyseg
    )
  )

# 2. Clean formatted display table
fmt_col <- function(x, is_count, is_usd, is_pct, is_small_mwh) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x)     ~ "—",
    is_count     ~ comma(round(x)),
    is_usd       ~ dollar(x, accuracy = 1),
    is_pct       ~ sprintf("%.2f%%", x),
    is_small_mwh ~ sprintf("%.4f", x),
    TRUE         ~ comma(x, accuracy = 0.01)
  )
}

final_summary_clean <- final_summary_raw |>
  mutate(
    is_count     = grepl("Batteries Deployed", Metric),
    is_usd       = grepl("\\$", Metric),
    is_pct       = grepl("\\(%\\)", Metric),
    Per_Battery  = fmt_col(Per_Battery,  is_count, is_usd, is_pct, TRUE),
    Subset_5k    = fmt_col(Subset_5k,    is_count, is_usd, is_pct, FALSE),
    Dataset_35k  = fmt_col(Dataset_35k,  is_count, is_usd, is_pct, FALSE),
    NYSEG_924k   = fmt_col(NYSEG_924k,   is_count, is_usd, is_pct, FALSE)
  ) |>
  select(Metric, Per_Battery, Subset_5k, Dataset_35k, NYSEG_924k)

print(final_summary_clean, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. PREPARE LAYERED DATA FROM sim_final
# ==============================================================================
# Flag which (month, day_type) profiles contain Top 100 critical strain hours
crit_days_tbl <- top100_slots |>
  distinct(month, day_type) |>
  mutate(has_crit_day = TRUE)

crit_hours_tbl <- top100_slots |>
  distinct(month, day_type, hour_ending) |>
  mutate(is_crit_hour = TRUE)

sim_layered <- sim_final |>
  left_join(crit_days_tbl, by = c("month", "day_type")) |>
  left_join(crit_hours_tbl, by = c("month", "day_type", "hour_ending")) |>
  mutate(
    has_crit_day = coalesce(has_crit_day, FALSE),
    is_crit_hour = coalesce(is_crit_hour, FALSE),
    tou_period   = factor(tou_period, levels = c("Off-peak", "Mid-peak", "Peak")),
    season       = factor(case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter (Dec–Feb)",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Spring (Mar–May)",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Summer (Jun–Aug)",
      TRUE                   ~ "Fall (Sep–Nov)"),
      levels = c("Winter (Dec–Feb)", "Spring (Mar–May)",
                 "Summer (Jun–Aug)", "Fall (Sep–Nov)")),
    # Isolate sub-cohort contributions alongside total blended VPP
    kwh_only_ev     = if_else(sub_segment == "Flexible EV Adopters (60%)", kwh_after, kwh_before),
    kwh_only_inflex = if_else(sub_segment == "Inflexible High-Peak (40%)", kwh_after, kwh_before)
  )

tou_colors <- c("Off-peak" = "#0077C8", "Mid-peak" = "#00853E", "Peak" = "#B57A14")

# ==============================================================================
# PLOT 1: 4-SEASON LAYERED OVERLAY (MATCHING YOUR PREVIOUS 4-SEASON GRAPH)
# ==============================================================================
season_lines <- sim_layered |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday") |>
  group_by(season, hour_ending, tou_period) |>
  summarise(
    `Baseline (no batteries)`                   = sum(kwh_before)      / 1000,
    `Final VPP Cohort (1.5% Blended: EV+Inflex)` = sum(kwh_after)       / 1000,
    `  Contribution: Flexible EVs (60% share)`  = sum(kwh_only_ev)     / 1000,
    `  Contribution: Inflexible (40% share)`    = sum(kwh_only_inflex) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Baseline (no batteries)`,
             `Final VPP Cohort (1.5% Blended: EV+Inflex)`,
             `  Contribution: Flexible EVs (60% share)`,
             `  Contribution: Inflexible (40% share)`),
    names_to = "curve",
    values_to = "total_mwh"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    curve = factor(curve, levels = c(
      "Baseline (no batteries)",
      "Final VPP Cohort (1.5% Blended: EV+Inflex)",
      "  Contribution: Flexible EVs (60% share)",
      "  Contribution: Inflexible (40% share)"
    ))
  )

season_shade <- season_lines |>
  filter(curve == "Baseline (no batteries)") |>
  group_by(season) |>
  mutate(block_id = cumsum(tou_period != lag(tou_period, default = first(tou_period)))) |>
  group_by(season, block_id, tou_period) |>
  summarise(
    xmin  = min(hour_ending) - 1,
    xmax  = max(hour_ending),
    mid_x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
    label = if_else((xmax - xmin) >= 2, as.character(first(tou_period)), ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

curve_colors <- c(
  "Baseline (no batteries)"                    = "#1B2A4A",
  "Final VPP Cohort (1.5% Blended: EV+Inflex)" = "#D62728",
  "  Contribution: Flexible EVs (60% share)"   = "#2CA02C",
  "  Contribution: Inflexible (40% share)"     = "#9467BD"
)

curve_types <- c(
  "Baseline (no batteries)"                    = "solid",
  "Final VPP Cohort (1.5% Blended: EV+Inflex)" = "solid",
  "  Contribution: Flexible EVs (60% share)"   = "dashed",
  "  Contribution: Inflexible (40% share)"     = "dotdash"
)

curve_widths <- c(
  "Baseline (no batteries)"                    = 1.2,
  "Final VPP Cohort (1.5% Blended: EV+Inflex)" = 1.15,
  "  Contribution: Flexible EVs (60% share)"   = 0.85,
  "  Contribution: Inflexible (40% share)"     = 0.85
)

p_final_4season <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = season_shade,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = tou_period),
            alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_text(data = season_shade,
            aes(x = mid_x, y = Inf, label = label),
            color = "grey30", vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_line(data = season_lines,
            aes(x = hour_ending - 0.5, y = total_mwh,
                color = curve, linetype = curve, linewidth = curve)) +
  facet_wrap(~ season, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tou_colors, name = "TOU Window") +
  scale_color_manual(values = curve_colors, name = "Load Profile") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = curve_types, name = "Load Profile") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = curve_widths, name = "Load Profile") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 4),
                     labels = c("12am", "4am", "8am", "12pm", "4pm", "8pm", "12am"),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.22))) +
  labs(
    title = "Final Simulation: Seasonal Fleet Load Shift Across TOU Layers",
    subtitle = "1.5% Adoption (60% Flexible EV + 40% Inflexible) | VPP Reserve Dispatch + 20% Backup Floor",
    x = "Time of Day",
    y = "Total Weekday Usage (MWh)"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
         linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
         linewidth = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12.5) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.5),
        legend.position = "top", legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(1.1, "lines"))

print(p_final_4season)

# ==============================================================================
# PLOT 2: NORMAL DAYS VS. PEAK CRITICAL STRAIN DAYS (LAYERED DISPATCH VIEW)
# ==============================================================================
regime_hourly <- sim_layered |>
  mutate(
    day_regime = factor(
      if_else(has_crit_day,
              "Peak Strain Days (VPP Hold + Top 100 Dispatch)",
              "Normal Routine Days (Standard TOU Arbitrage)"),
      levels = c("Normal Routine Days (Standard TOU Arbitrage)",
                 "Peak Strain Days (VPP Hold + Top 100 Dispatch)")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(day_regime, month, day_type, hour_ending, tou_period, is_crit_hour) |>
  summarise(
    mw_before      = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, kwh_before      / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
    mw_after       = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, kwh_after       / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
    mw_only_ev     = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, kwh_only_ev     / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
    mw_only_inflex = sum(if_else(n_hours > 0, kwh_only_inflex / n_hours, 0)) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(day_regime, hour_ending) |>
  summarise(
    # Dominant TOU & critical window for shading
    tou_period   = names(which.max(table(tou_period))),
    pct_crit_hr  = mean(is_crit_hour),
    `Baseline (no batteries)`                   = mean(mw_before),
    `Final VPP Cohort (1.5% Blended: EV+Inflex)` = mean(mw_after),
    `  Contribution: Flexible EVs (60% share)`  = mean(mw_only_ev),
    `  Contribution: Inflexible (40% share)`    = mean(mw_only_inflex),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(tou_period = factor(tou_period, levels = c("Off-peak", "Mid-peak", "Peak")))

regime_lines <- regime_hourly |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Baseline (no batteries)`,
             `Final VPP Cohort (1.5% Blended: EV+Inflex)`,
             `  Contribution: Flexible EVs (60% share)`,
             `  Contribution: Inflexible (40% share)`),
    names_to = "curve",
    values_to = "avg_mw"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    curve = factor(curve, levels = names(curve_colors))
  )

regime_shade <- regime_hourly |>
  group_by(day_regime) |>
  mutate(block_id = cumsum(tou_period != lag(tou_period, default = first(tou_period)))) |>
  group_by(day_regime, block_id, tou_period) |>
  summarise(
    xmin  = min(hour_ending) - 1,
    xmax  = max(hour_ending),
    mid_x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
    label = if_else((xmax - xmin) >= 2, as.character(first(tou_period)), ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Top 100 critical strain window overlay layer for the Peak Strain panel
crit_window_rect <- regime_hourly |>
  filter(day_regime == "Peak Strain Days (VPP Hold + Top 100 Dispatch)",
         pct_crit_hr > 0) |>
  summarise(
    day_regime = first(day_regime),
    xmin = min(hour_ending) - 1,
    xmax = max(hour_ending),
    mid_x = (xmin + xmax) / 2
  )

p_peak_vs_normal <- ggplot() +
  # Layer 1: TOU background bands
  geom_rect(data = regime_shade,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = tou_period),
            alpha = 0.18) +
  # Layer 2: Highlighted Top 100 Critical Dispatch Window on Peak Days
  geom_rect(data = crit_window_rect,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "#D62728", alpha = 0.14, color = "#D62728",
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = regime_shade,
            aes(x = mid_x, y = Inf, label = label),
            color = "grey30", vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = crit_window_rect,
            aes(x = mid_x, y = -Inf, label = "Top 100 Critical\nDispatch Window"),
            color = "#A61C1C", vjust = -0.5, size = 3.1, fontface = "bold") +
  # Layer 3: Load curves
  geom_line(data = regime_lines,
            aes(x = hour_ending - 0.5, y = avg_mw,
                color = curve, linetype = curve, linewidth = curve)) +
  facet_wrap(~ day_regime, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tou_colors, name = "TOU Window") +
  scale_color_manual(values = curve_colors, name = "Load Profile") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = curve_types, name = "Load Profile") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = curve_widths, name = "Load Profile") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 4),
                     labels = c("12am", "4am", "8am", "12pm", "4pm", "8pm", "12am"),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.14, 0.22))) +
  labs(
    title = "Normal Routine Days vs. Peak Strain Days (Final VPP Simulation)",
    subtitle = "Showing daily TOU arbitrage on normal days vs. pre-event hold & evening Top 100 discharge on peak days",
    x = "Time of Day",
    y = "Average Fleet Demand (MW)"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
         linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
         linewidth = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12.5) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.5),
        legend.position = "top", legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"))

print(p_peak_vs_normal)
```
